Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment here of the MARVEL Future Fight team.

 

In this update we introduce you to the Danger Room! Join 3 vs 3 battles with friends and rivals to take your Heroes to even greater heights!
But wait, there’s more! We have new characters joining the Marvel Future Fight roster this September!
Refer to the details below for all the awesome content and characters coming your way:

 

3 New Characters are coming to Marvel Future Fight!
These Mutants are here to shake things up! Kitty Pryde, Rachel Summers and Kid Omega have been added!

On top of that, characters empowered by the all powerful Phoenix Force will come to your aid!
Cyclops, Colossus, and Emma Frost will be getting new Uniforms!
 
A total of 4 Mutant will have their Potentials unlocked in order to unleash their full power.
Along with this, the first leader of the Mutant, Cyclops, can now be upgraded to Tier-3.
 
Together with the new additions, we’ve added new content to help Agents utilize the power of the new Mutants.
As previously mentioned, a total of 6 Agents can participate in a real-time battle in the Danger Room! 
Additional improvements have been made to the Alliance Tournament scoring and rewards system!

 


▣ 3 New Characters added:

 

Kitty Pryde, a Mutant who can freely phase through solid objects,
Rachel Summers, daughter of Jean Gray and a host to the power of the Phoenix Force,
And finally, the Omega Level Mutant, Kid Omega enters the fray. 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

* New Characters’ Skills are based on Level 1.

 

 

 ▣ Added 3 New Uniforms
 

Meet the Mutants who have embraced the power of the Phoenix! Use their new power through their new uniforms.

New Uniforms for Cyclops/Colossus/Emma Frost have been added.

 

 

* Uniform Skills are based on Level 1.
* The 3 new uniforms will be sold at a discounted price during the event period.
* You can check out the uniforms and purchase them in the MARVEL Universe or the uniform Room even after the event period.

 

▣ 4 More Characters Can Now Realize Their Potential and New Tier-3 Character

 

In the September update Kitty Pryde, Rachel Summers, Kid Omega and Cyclops will have their Potential open and can reach level 70.

 

 


The first of the Mutants and their leader Cyclops have been upgraded. Defeat your foes with his powerful energy!
 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Added Danger Room (Beta Test)

 

The Danger Room, a new in-game content, has been added.
The Danger Room was created to help train unique individuals, such as our Agents, including new characters like Rachel Summers and Kid Omega.

 

Up to 6 Agents can participate in the Danger Room to battle it out in 3v3 format. 
The first team to defeat the designated boss will be crowned the victor of the battle.
 

* Please note that Danger Room will only be open in beta testing phase and may experience issues from time to time. We will be holding a community event after everyone’s had a chance to try it out in order to collect your feedback and improve the game mode as we go on. 
 

I hope to see you all participate in our latest mode!

 

For more information about Danger Room, you can refer to our Danger Room Guide
[Danger Room Guide]

 

- The Danger Room will reset every Sunday at 3:00 PM (UTC+0) | 8:00 AM (PDT).
- The Danger Room will be available for Agents who have cleared Story Mission Chapter 3-5. 
- The Danger Room has no entry limit. You may enter the Danger Room as many times as you want as long as you have the Energy for it.


When you enter the Danger Room, you will be placed in a private lobby. You can invite up to 3 other Agents from your Friends List or Alliance members.
 

 

- Master of the lobby can start the session without any preparations. If the session starts without 3 Agents, random Agents will be teamed up automatically.
- Jean Grey, Magneto, and Stryfe will be available during specific schedules until the season ends.
- Each season will run for one week and will reset every Sunday at 3:00 PM (UTC+0) | 8:00 AM (PDT) 
 

Once a match has been made, you can select one of the specified characters from the weekly Character list. 
Each character has their own Exclusive Skills that can help defeat the opponents. 
 

 

- You cannot select duplicate characters in the Danger Room.
- Characters you do not own and already used can still be selected, the stats (tier/rank/level/mastery/skill/gear level)  and equipment of the Characters will be automatically adjusted to balance the situation.

 

You can check the Exclusive Skill by tapping on a character’s portrait from the character list that is shown before you enter the Lobby

 

 

 

 

- Battles in the Danger Room can only be played in Manual battle. You must use each character’s exclusive skill to win the battle.
 

 

In order to use an Exclusive Skill, you need to acquire skill energy that drops during the battle.
Skill Energy is automatically acquired if a character approaches it. The exclusive skill becomes available after acquiring a specific amount of skill energy. 

 

If a character dies in battle, they can revive after 10 seconds.
Fight with your team to achieve victory!! 

 

-Even if your hero dies, you will get to keep your current skill energy.
 

Once the battle is over, a rewards window will pop up along with your results.

 

 

There are 3 main rewards in the Danger Room: Proficiency Rewards, First Win of the Day Rewards and Ranking Rewards.
Proficiency rewards can be earned through your experience in battle, and will be rewarded according to your wins or losses.
 

■First Win of the Day

 

This is the reward that you can acquire when you participate in the Danger Room and win your first victory! This can only be earned once a day with X-Genes and additional Proficiency Level Exp. 

 

[List of X-Gene First Victory Reward].

 

 

* The rewards are based on the September Update and may be changed later on.

 

■Proficiency Rewards

 

Proficiency rewards can be obtained through the experience you gain in battles, and will be awarded according to your win/loss ratio.
Each time you earn 100% reward points, your proficiency level will increase, and a chest will be rewarded.
 

 

 

[List of Proficiency Chest Rewards]  

* You can obtain 1 item from the list at a certain chance.

 

■Ranking Rewards

 

Ranking Rewards will be sent directly to your Inbox upon re-entering the Danger Room after the end of the season.
You can earn various rewards from the each Reward Chest including X-Genes for different Characters, including Kid Omega.
 

 

[List of Rank Reward Box Items]

* The rewards are based on the September update and may be changed later on.
 

 

▣ Danger Room Special Package! Rachel Summer’s Special Training!

 

The Danger Room will allow you to make specific Heroes stronger using special training packages.
If you clear the quests that are available for a specific time period after your purchase of this product, you will receive a variety of rewards, including 1,250 Crystals!

 

 

 

 

- You can get Rachel Summers as a 6★ character after purchasing the Rachel Summers Special Training Package directly. You can advance Rachel Summers to Tier-2 by completing her quest.
- Earn additional rewards by clearing the quests that become available after purchasing this package!


*This package can be purchased once. Special Training Quests can only be played within 60 days after purchase to receive the rewards.
*Rachel Summers’ Special Training Package will be on sale until 11/9(Sat)

* Rachel Summer's Special Training Package will become available for purchase again in the future

 

[Rachel Summers’ Special Training Quest rewards]

* You must complete all the quests in the Special Training Package in order to earn each reward

 

▣ Other Game Improvements

 

1. All in-game products have been changed to be sent to the Items tab of your Inbox.  

- Subscription based products will take effect once they are opened from the Inbox. 
* Refunds may be difficult to process once a subscription based product is opened.


2. Improved Alliance Tournament scoring system
 
Previously: Up to 10,000 points awarded per plate based on 100% HP wins.
New: Bonus points are calculated based on remaining time even if you win with 100% HP on the 4th battle.


3. Improvements to the Uru combine window to automatically return to the selection window after combining Urus.
 
4. Unlocking S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy’s Uniform Upgrade Mission has been changed.
- Existing: Obtain 1 Uniform
- Changed: No Condition

 

▣ Other Fixes
 
1. Fixed and issue in the Giant Boss Raid where Galactus will clip into the map. 
2. Fixed an issue in Legendary Battle for Avengers: Endgame where assets would not be loaded properly during certain cutscenes.
3. Fixed an issue where some characters would encounter targeting issues with counterattack.
4. Fixed an issue where the LG V50’s dual screen would crash when other screens were opened simultaneously with MARVEL Future Fight.
5. Fixed an issue where Spider-Man [All-New, All-Different] uniform’s Web debuff would appear as invisible.
6. The 4★ character portrait in the Co-op Play Guide has been fixed to show Lv. 40 (maximum) instead of Lv. 60
7. Fixed a character usage tip error with Electro’s Skill description
(Accumulating the damage you’ve dealt → Accumulating the damage you’ve received)
8. Fixed an issue with Juggernaut’s Tier-2 Skill [Cyttorak’s Avatar] where the skill’s name is not displayed from icon ToolTip when the skill is activated.
 

Are you ready for the next mission with the Mutants?

 

Until next time!
